rules.title: Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate a tenancy without just cause (at-fault reasons such as failure to pay rent, nuisance, or illegal use; or no-fault reasons such as owner move-in, demolition, or removal from the rental market). Landlords must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO). This includes buildings newer than October 1, 1978 and properties containing only one single-family dwelling. It applies to a tenancy once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease has expired, whichever comes first.
rules.exemptions: Units regulated by the RSO. Exceptions include, but are not limited to: transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, the owner's roommate, cooperatives under certain circumstances, some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term treatment centers for substance abuse, and some properties owned by HACLA or the government.
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.interaction_text: The JCO covers most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

rules.title: Evictions for Non-Payment of Rent (Fair Market Rent threshold)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR) for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.key_value: Amount owed must exceed the Fair Market Rent (FMR) for the unit's bedroom size
rules.coverage_text: All RSO and JCO rental units in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR).

rules.title: Eviction Notices Filed with LAHD
rules.requirement: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.
rules.key_value: within three (3) business days of service
rules.coverage_text: All JCO and RSO rental properties in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.quoted_span: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (AB 1482) rent cap
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the regional cost of living, or 10%, whichever is lower. The maximum allowable increase was 8.9% from August 1, 2024 to July 31, 2025.
rules.key_value: 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region, or 10%, whichever is lower
rules.coverage_text: Buildings older than 15 years, on a rolling basis.
